properties.value: java.util.Random (non-cryptographic PRNG) used by numberBetween() to compute a fractional order number between two items during drag-and-drop list reordering in ReorderModal.kt:374 (calculateOrderNum). Non-security purpose — UI ordering only — but it is the only PRNG in the tree; kept as a C-rated weak-random site. Not a security-relevant randomness consumer; would only matter if reused for tokens/IDs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Android app-signing keystore committed to the repo, in PKCS#12 (pfx) format. Signs the debug build type (app/build.gradle.kts:70) AND the distributed "demo" build type (app/build.gradle.kts:89). Its store/key password is hardcoded in plaintext at app/build.gradle.kts:33 and :35 ("IVY7834!DEbug"), so anyone with repo read access can extract the signing key — that pairing is the real exposure. Release signing correctly uses env vars + separate sign.jks.
